AS-ACL-0001.locator: ACL Schedule 2, consumer guarantees - TO-VERIFY page
AS-ACL-0001.statement: Consumer guarantees under the Australian Consumer Law apply regardless of any plan and cannot be excluded; plan decisions never limit statutory rights.

AS-ELIG-0001.statement: Only devices listed in the current device catalog are eligible for enrolment.

AS-ELIG-0004.locator: purchase-window clause pattern - TO-VERIFY (synthesized tier values, demo product)
AS-ELIG-0004.statement: A device may only be enrolled within a maximum period after purchase; the window depends on the plan tier (demo tiers: basic 48, standard 36, plus 24 months).

AS-ELIG-0010.locator: grading-based acceptance pattern - TO-VERIFY (synthesized tier values, demo product)
AS-ELIG-0010.statement: The maximum pre-existing screen damage severity admissible at enrolment depends on the plan tier (demo: basic/standard up to moderate, plus up to cosmetic).

AS-ELIG-0011.statement: A device older than the enrolment window for the requested tier cannot be enrolled on that tier.

AS-EXCL-0002.statement: A device that does not power on cannot be assessed remotely and is not eligible for enrolment.

AS-EXCL-0005.statement: Structural deformation (bent frame or body) present at enrolment excludes the device from cover.

AS-EXCL-0006.statement: Visible corrosion in ports indicates prior liquid exposure; such devices are excluded from enrolment.

AS-EXCL-0007.locator: pre-existing damage endorsement pattern - TO-VERIFY (synthesized, demo product)
AS-EXCL-0007.statement: Pre-existing screen damage of moderate or worse severity attaches a screen-damage exclusion endorsement to the plan; the plan covers the device except the screen.

AS-EXCL-0008.locator: pre-existing damage endorsement pattern - TO-VERIFY (synthesized, demo product)
AS-EXCL-0008.statement: Pre-existing back-glass damage of moderate or worse severity attaches a back-glass exclusion endorsement.

AS-EXCL-0009.statement: Cosmetic housing wear present at enrolment is noted as a cosmetic waiver and is not claimable.

AS-EXCL-0012.locator: grading-based acceptance pattern - TO-VERIFY (synthesized, demo product)
AS-EXCL-0012.statement: A device whose screen condition exceeds the admissible severity for the requested tier, and for which no endorsement is available on that tier, cannot be enrolled on that tier.

AS-ICA-0001.locator: Insurance Contracts Act 1984 (Cth) Division 1A consumer duty - TO-VERIFY exact section
AS-ICA-0001.statement: The applicant must take reasonable care not to make a misrepresentation; a declaration contradicted by observed evidence bars enrolment pending review.

AS-REF-0000.statement: Any case not covered by an explicit rule is referred to human review; the system never defaults to approval.

AS-REF-0001.statement: Observed damage that does not map to the closed taxonomy is referred to human review.

AS-REF-0002.statement: Failure of the on-screen challenge-code verification refers the case to human review.

AS-REF-0003.statement: A fraud belief in the uncertain band refers the case to human review.

AS-REF-0004.statement: A fraud belief in the reject band refers the case to fraud review.

AS-REF-0005.statement: A decision whose derivation depends on a stale knowledge assertion is downgraded to human review.

AS-REF-0006.statement: Severe damage suspected from a single view but not confirmed across views is referred to human review.

AS-REF-0007.statement: If any required input is missing, the outcome is 'insufficient information'; the system never guesses missing inputs.
